scope: Verified native Anthropic citations; not full M4 acceptance
checks: Explicit Anthropic native_citations capability; captured hash-verified passages become inline citation-enabled documents.

Native document indexes resolve only within the outgoing captured-source registry. A unique exact match normalizes character ranges to UTF-16 excerpt offsets; mismatched, unsupported and ambiguous ranges are rejected.
Buffered and streamed ranges produce bounded, hash-verified exact quotes. Model-written numeric evidence markers are removed.
Tool continuations send each captured body once and count those bytes before usage reservation.
Storage revalidates source identity, span boundaries, quote bytes and hashes before answer settlement. Revision/deletion states and purge retain their existing guarantees.
CLI and desktop/phone browser display exact quotes with the original passage snapshot retained in the API.
Reviewed additive OpenAPI/YAML contracts. Historical M2 quality recordings remain unchanged; the replay verifies passage granularity before omitting only that added field.
limitations: Provider protocol and full workflow checks use controlled local HTTP responses and synthetic data; no live Anthropic account or model quality claim.
The browser fixture uses direct text capture, not a new real-export or extractor qualification.

Full hardened deployment, sustained-write full daemon restore, mounted external roots, large-corpus qualification, off-server key custody, signed release/SBOM/CI and remaining real-export semantic acceptance remain open.
